rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when something is clearly apparent.

example.english: They obviously don't want to see anyone today.
example.traditional: 好明顯佢今日唔想見人。
example.jyutping: hou2 ming4 hin2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 soeng2 gin3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the evidence is so apparent that one can know it at a glance.

example.english: You can obviously tell at a glance that this photo is fake.
example.traditional: 一睇就知呢張相係假嘅。
example.jyutping: jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 hai6 gaa2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something is obvious despite someone denying it or acting otherwise.

example.english: You obviously said you wouldn't eat spicy food, so why did you order spicy chicken?
example.traditional: 你明明話咗唔食辣，點解又叫辣雞？
example.jyutping: nei5 ming4 ming4 waa6 zo2 m4 sik6 laat6 dim2 gaai2 jau6 giu3 laat6 gai1
